attributes.name: Druva - High Volume File Encryption
attributes.description: Detects high volume file encryption in Druva Data Security Cloud events.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 4 – Ransomware & Unusual Data Activity

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 4 – Ransomware & Unusual Data Activity
meta.customer_usecase: Detects high volume file encryption in Druva Data Security Cloud events.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.file.encrypted_count >= 1000
| KEEP @timestamp, event.id, event.action, event.outcome, event.severity, druva.feature, druva.event_type, user.name, user.email, source.ip, druva.resource.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 100
